scope: Extremely small hypothetical synthetic controlled-DC-port speed ablation, not hardware calibration or a validated DC/DC model. No strategy comparison.

baseline.evidence: Existing reconstructed-then-rerun V2.1 preconditioned .4 sag trajectories; do not rerun unchanged baseline.

hypothetical_fast_port.calibration_status: Assumed 10x speed sensitivity only; not inferred from ABB interface timing, dispatch updates or vendor DC-loop measurements.

duration.meaning: Two seconds after scheduled clearance, unless original hard-stop events terminate.

identical_other_parameters: All ratings, capacitance, losses, efficiencies, source power command bounds, Q-priority allocation, PI/PLL/DC feedback gains, modulation limits, control100us clock, one-sample queue and full initial state remain identical. Only declared source tau/ramp change.
initial_state_scope: Both fast tests start from identical existing .6s full state, without reprerun/reset. This is a same-state port-speed sensitivity, not an independently qualified fast-port periodic initial state. The fast no-fault run records its own startup and becomes the matched reference.

numerics.refine_rule: Repeat only same fast fault if actual current/DC/AC P/S margin is within0.001 of its normalized hard boundary, or if a boundary contact occurs. Never change physical conditions to force a result.
numerics.method: Unchanged DOP853 rotating-dq physical/controller functions; rtol1e-10,atol1e-8, exact control/fault/stop boundaries.
numerics.independent_abc: Not repeated for this hypothetical source-speed test; shared fixed-model component audit already exists. No claim of new independent topology validation.

metrics: Actual I, AC P/S, DC-link, battery power/SoC, modulation and PLL limits; first hard contacts; source behavior; same-time full normalized electrical state versus fast no-fault reference; inherited self-cycle+target convergence; both net and irreversible absolute P/Q service integrals; battery inventory difference, never erased service deficit.
recovery: 3 successive50ms checks with preceding50ms target difference and self-cycle difference<=1e-5; hard safe/unclipped150ms and PLL error<=1mHz; do not call global safe recovery if any earlier hard violation occurred.
storage: All100us full state/control and interval extrema; fast fault dense10/5us rows from onset through50ms after clearance and around any near-hard-boundary interval; no-fault dense output not retained. Every new trajectory marked new diagnostic, never historical recovery.
